verdict.rationale: Ask Digits is a built-in AI financial assistant that answers natural-language questions about cash flow, expenses, revenue, vendors, budgets and forecasts, and claims a task mode ("Ask Digits to Get it Done"). Separately, the official hosted MCP server lets users query live ledger data in natural language from Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and Perplexity, and a probe confirms that endpoint is live and auth-gated. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of which tasks Ask Digits can actually perform via natural language, write or action capability through the MCP path (it is read-only), and independent hands-on corroboration of natural-language operation.
